notes: Authors from Wind Value, the Re-Wind Network and IEA Wind Task 45 carried out research on methods of processing end-of-life wind turbine blades. This included a structured literature review which selected the literature in the Excel file. Part of this work helps to estimate the value of an end-of-life wind farm contributing to Work Package 5.1 of the Wind Value project. The paper was pubished as Deeney et al. (2025) End-of-life wind turbine blades and paths to a circular economy, Renewable and Sustainable Energy Reviews.
title: Wind Value Literature Selection for End-of-Life Valuation Excel File WP 5.1
